cues: Queen Elizabeth the First and Henry the Fourth of France lived among fanatics on both sides of a religious war, stayed free of the errors of their time, and were both beneficial and effective.
Abraham Lincoln conducted a great war without ever departing from wisdom.
text: Is wisdom weak, then? History says not. Queen Elizabeth the First and Henry the Fourth of France lived among fanatics on both sides of a religious war, stayed free of the errors of their time, and were both beneficial and effective. Abraham Lincoln conducted a great war without ever departing from wisdom. Wisdom is not weakness.
